what: Root Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies], beside 01108: delete line 177 `toolchain = { path = "crates/toolchain", version = "0.0.0" }`. No member depends on it any more (blaze-cargo dropped it: its fetch test runs git with std::process::Command; v2 runs no rustc, so nothing discovers cargo/rustc executables). `toolchain::` hits in blaze-cargo, hir-ty-codegen and blaze-engine are their own modules. Once applied, dedup deletes crates/toolchain. Can go in the same apply as 01108.
